strings.do.arch.body: {n} memories filed under {domain} will be archived, subdomains included. Reversible: the level stays in the tree, marked archived, and can be restored.

strings.do.arch.nothing: Nothing to archive under this domain

strings.do.case.preserveHint: Policy is Preserve — nothing to normalize.

strings.do.norm.title: Normalize domains
strings.do.rest.body: {n} archived memories under {domain} go back to active, subdomains included.

strings.ov.axis.organization.why: Share of active memories with a title, tags that are more than the type, and a domain — the three things that find a memory by something other than its own wording.
